adjudication.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, the loop `rss.items.each do |i|` directly calls `i.content.scrub` and then `TopicEmbed.import(...)` with no per-item error handling. If an item has `i.content == nil` (making `.scrub` raise `NoMethodError`) or if `TopicEmbed.import` raises for any item, the exception will abort the entire job and skip all subsequent feed items. This is exacerbated by `sidekiq_options retry: false`, so a single bad item can prevent later items from ever being imported until the next successful run.
